Priya —

Thanks for the upload and the summary. Reviewed the traces and the dashboard; nice work capturing bursts. Quick take (high level):

- Sizing: based on the workload shape (longer prompts, frequent KV cache misses during chaotic bursts) I recommend a starting pool of 10x NVIDIA A100 equivalent vGPUs (we can map to H100 if you want lower p99 latency but cost rises). That gives ~15–20% headroom for the 4.1k synthetic spikes and keeps 95th pctl closer to 220–260ms in our tests (see annotated notes).
- Commit tiers: 3 options we typically propose:
  * Starter: 6 vGPU equivalent — $60k/mo commit — marginally higher tail latency under long bursts
  * Recommended: 10 vGPU equivalent — $125k/mo commit — target for your 3.5k sustained TPS
  * High-headroom: 14 vGPU equivalent — $170k/mo commit — >30% headroom for growth/bursting

Baseline pricing above assumes a 12-month commit. We usually start at list and layer a discount based on commit size. I'm including a proposed pricing sheet (proposed-pricing-sheet.xlsx) with modeled monthly costs including reserved discounts and projected token volumes.

Two commercial levers I suggest we discuss: guaranteed throughput SLO (with credits on missed throughput windows) and a temporary burst pool (20% burst free for the first 90 days). If you want deeper latency SLAs we can look at H100-backed pools.

I'll loop in Laura/Rishi for formal discount guidance and to double-check the sizing/latency numbers from the infra side.

Attachments: acme-benchmark-results-20260624.pdf (annotated)

Best,
Ben Carter

Engineer note (for procurement):
- Workload profile: median prompt length ~420 tokens, heavy multi-turn context leading to non-trivial KV cache churn. Steady-state token rate corresponds to ~3.5k TPS for the mix observed.
- Mapping: in our benchmark harness the A100-equivalent vGPU provides ~350–380 effective TPS for this workload with our optimized kernels and batching. Conservatively: use 350 TPS per vGPU to account for production variance.
- Recommendation: 10 vGPU-equivalents -> ~3,500 TPS conservative sustained. We recommend 14 if Acme wants 30% headroom for growth or consistent bursts. For lower latency guarantees (p95/p99) we offer an H100-backed profile (est. 15–20% lower p99 but ~1.4x cost).
- SLA/credit approach suggestion: define monthly throughput windows (1hr rolling windows) where sustained throughput falls below 90% of committed throughput -> credit = pro-rated days up to 10% of that month's committed spend.
